steps.note: S2.3.1.1 traces rows 0-7 with initial scratch a,c and concludes the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of a and c, matching the paper.
States the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one pairs, and self coefficient one.
States the complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, side cancellation for intersections zero and two, intersection one giving zero and self coefficient one.
Gives forward, inverse, forward stages taking (x,y) to (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x), each invocation restoring its own scratch wires.

The plan asserts that every edge joins nested labels and that splitting A=B⊥P and F=<t>⊥t^⊥ gives the other residuals (S2.3.3.1.6, S2.3.3.1.8), but never lists the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions.
S2.3.3.1.7 states that t_X⊥t_Y gives <t_X>⊂t_Y^⊥ on the side edge 2→5, with complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2.
The only decreasing edges are center 3→4, each losing h, and gate-wise telescoping gives sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich.

States that over F2 every residual is nondegenerate, every nonzero one contains a norm-one vector and so is nonalternating and has an orthonormal basis; it omits only the plane-absorption construction, which the checklist gives as parenthetical.
States L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, derived from L/N=3ch/v with the paper's parameters.
Gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U=Σ wt(v)[v·x] over an orthonormal residual basis, with the sign reversed on decreasing edges.
States that wt(v) is odd, so the phase is i^{ε[v·x]}, and that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.
States that on k columns each residual vector contributes one factor acting on all columns, with s_c factors in all (in the quote).

Gives the zero-label frame I and full-label frame C^{⊗m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and negation of the physical X outputs.
States that both loss ratios are below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b is positive and s<Wm (S2.3.4.5), with the complex deficit 2N-2L_c in S2.3.5.3.
States η_b=339/22587335000000 exactly.
States η_c=73/19906842167500 exactly.
States that both deficits exceed 20·2^{-50} and that log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η), so s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}.
Describes the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing left and below, repetition on the remaining indices, and Π with exactly a ones.

The claim fixes an odd prime q for a fixed finite set of matrices, and the method factors A=E1ΠE2 once and for all and picks q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators, so the shear runs over Z/q^b.
States that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from earlier, still-original coordinates.
Gives D_j←D_j+H_i, the interchange, D_j←H_i-D_j taking (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange, a in all.
States E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, ν as the least j with m^j≥B, C_0=128m(s+E)^2, C_1=20 and Δ=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉; the general form C_1=max{20,ν+3} and the value ν=11 are not stated.
States A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)≤8e at leaves, with one invocation adding fewer than E operations (at most 12W gates of at most 2W^2 operations plus corrections).

S2.5.5.1 asserts the unrolled bound A(e)≤8B^2d^{ν+1} and S2.5.5 asserts the total is within Δ, but the unrolling step B^{k+1}≤B^2d^ν (from sx+E≤Bx and B≤m^ν) and the accounting of pieces, outer phases and shift that brings the total below C_0d^{C_1} are not given.
States that depth t gives values in 2^{-(p+t)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^t, that p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer bits are exact, and that εC_1<1 gives Δ=o(p).
States that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P05 follows the paper's lemma-level derivations closely, usually quoting the paper's own lines, and has 24 of 26 sub-steps present. Two are absent. L1: the per-edge residual table with its dimensions is never listed. S3: the unrolling B^{k+1}≤B^2d^ν and the total below C_0d^{C_1} are asserted rather than derived. S1 counts as present, although it gives C_1 only as 20, not as max{20,ν+3} with ν=11.
